scripts.generate: npm run prepare:tokens && npm run prepare:docs && npm run prepare:landing
scripts.build: npm run generate && npm run build -ws
scripts.check: node scripts/check-dist.mjs docs/dist landing/dist --sidebar docs/astro.config.mjs --host https://minuspod.app=landing/dist --host https://docs.minuspod.app=docs/dist
scripts.deploy:docs: npm run generate && npm run build -w docs && wrangler deploy --config docs/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:landing: npm run generate && npm run build -w landing && wrangler deploy --config landing/wrangler.jsonc
